 (through Vc).

Coram:
 Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Amit Sharma
 Order
1.  This hearing has been done through hybrid mode.

CM APPL. 6551/2026 (early hearing)
2.

The present application under Section 151 of the CPC read with Article 227 of the Constitution of India, 1950, seeks following prayers:-
"a) Direct early hearing / expedited listing of the accompanying petition on humanitarian and child welfare grounds, in view of the Petitioner's acquittal in FIR No. 16/2018, PS South Avenue, under Sections 376/363/366/468/471 IPC and the fact that he has not met his minor son since 2018; and b) Pass such other or further order(s) as this Hon'ble Court may deem fit and proper in the interest of justice and welfare of the minor child."
3. None appears on behalf of the petitioner/applicant.
4. The captioned petition is already listed before this Court for 19.02.2026.
5.
In view thereof, no grounds for early hearing have been made out.
This is a digitally signed order.
